scope: First researched sample: 12 sourced introductions in five villages, three published geographic reference points; not an exhaustive inventory, field survey, entrance list, boarding-point list or operating service.
coordinateTransformation: No datum conversion. Published decimal WGS84 coordinates retained; DMS independently checked using degrees + minutes/60 + seconds/3600.
